facts: Parties: Kestrel Medical Ltd (Buyer), Calloway Logistics plc (Seller); the Company is Foxley Industries Ltd.
This Agreement is dated 6 March 2026; Closing is scheduled for 3 June 2026 (the 'Closing Date').

Section 1.1: 'Material Adverse Change' means any event which has a material adverse effect on the business of the Company, excluding changes in general economic conditions, changes affecting the industry generally, and pandemics.

Clause 14.2: either party may terminate this agreement on 30 days' notice if the other party undergoes a change of control without its prior written consent. The counterparty is Lowther Engineering Ltd.
Disclosure against Warranty 6.3 (Material Contracts): no material contract contains a change of control provision. (No further disclosure.)

Disclosure against Warranty 8.2 (IP): the Company's core platform software was developed in 2023 by an independent contractor, Redcliffe Robotics Ltd. No written assignment of intellectual property was entered into.
Item 5: the board noted a letter before action from Delamere Bioscience plc threatening proceedings for approximately $1,200,000 in respect of alleged defective deliveries. Management to monitor.
